introduction.text: Forte Aurelia Antica is a historic fort in Rome’s Gianicolense district, built in the late 19th century as part of a network of 15 forts. It has served military, humanitarian, and law‑enforcement roles and is currently undergoing restoration.

history.description: Construction of Forte Aurelia Antica began in 1877 and was completed in 1881.
The fort is one of 15 forts built in Rome between 1877 and 1891.
Since 1958 the fort has been occupied by a Guardia di Finanza logistics centre.
Since 2017 the entire complex is undergoing a comprehensive restoration and conservation project.
After the Second World War the fort housed 8,000 displaced persons and later served as a hospital.
